78117-democracy-false-or-true.title: and Dream
78117-democracy-false-or-true.creator: Sir William Blake Richmond
78117-democracy-false-or-true.description: A book by Sir William Blake Richmond. Jesus Christ, Moses, Hamurrabbi, and Mohammed, Plato, Sir Thomas More, and, when I come to think of it, all leaders of thought have played with the bricks of that entertaining place. I imagine that the folk, who think at all, form a picture of their preference, which includes the future with the present.

arxiv-1810-07624.title: Best proximity point results for almost contraction and application to nonlinear differential equation
arxiv-1810-07624.creator: Azhar Hussain Mujahid Abbas, Muhammad Adeel Tanzeela Kanwal
arxiv-1810-07624.description: Abstract Abstract Brinde [Approximating fixed points of weak contractions using the Picard itration, Nonlinear Anal. Forum 9 (2004), 43-53] introduced almost contraction mappings and proved Banach contraction principle for such mappings. The aim of this paper is to introduce the notion of multivalued almost \Theta -contraction mappings and present some best proximity point results for this new class of mappings.

arxiv-2006-06388.title: Rational 2 2 -Functions are abelian
arxiv-2006-06388.creator: L. Felipe Müller
arxiv-2006-06388.description: Abstract . We show that the coefficients of rational 2 2 -functions are contained in an abelian number field. More precisely, we show that the poles of such functions are poles of order one and given by roots of unity and rational residue. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 81Q60, 30C10; Secondary: 33B30. 1.

arxiv-2012-00064.title: A new approach to the gender pay gap decomposition by economic activity Supported by the MINECO grants MTM2017-82724-R, MTM2015-71217-R, and by the Xunta de Galicia (Grupos de Referencia Competitiva ED431C-2016-015 and Centro Singular de Investigación de Galicia ED431G/01), all of them through the E
arxiv-2012-00064.creator: María José Lombardía 1 , Esther López-Vizcaíno 2 Cristina Rueda 3 1 Universidade da Coruña, CITIC, Spain, 2 Instituto Galego de Estatística, Spain, 3 Universidad de Valladolid, Spain
arxiv-2012-00064.description: Abstract Abstract The aim of this paper is to present an original approach to estimate the gender pay gap. We propose a model-based decomposition, similar to the most popular approaches, where the first component measures differences in group characteristics and the second component measures the unexplained effect; the latter being the real gap.

arxiv-2207-02901.title: A signature index for third order topological insulators
arxiv-2207-02901.creator: L.B Drissi, E.H Saidi 1- LPHE, Modeling & Simulations, Faculty of Science, Mohammed V University, Rabat, Morocco.2- CPM, Centre of Physics and Mathematics, Mohammed V University in Rabat, Morocco.3- Peter Grünberg Institut and Institute for Advanced Simulation, Forschungszentrum Jülich & JARA, D-524
arxiv-2207-02901.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by L.B Drissi, E.H Saidi 1- LPHE, Modeling & Simulations, Faculty of Science, Mohammed V University, Rabat, Morocco.2- CPM, Centre of Physics and Mathematics, Mohammed V University in Rabat, Morocco.3- Peter Grünberg Institut and Institute for Advanced Simulation, Forschungszentrum Jülich & JARA, D-524. In this work, we develop an index signature characterising the third order topological phases in 3D systems. This index is an alternating sum of monomial signatures of Higgs triplet values at 3D corners.

arxiv-2306-09805.title: Mimicking Better by Matching the Approximate Action Distribution
arxiv-2306-09805.creator: João A. Cândido Ramos, Lionel Blondé, Naoya Takeishi, Alexandros Kalousis
arxiv-2306-09805.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce MAAD, a novel, sample-efficient on-policy algorithm for Imitation Learning from Observations. MAAD utilizes a surrogate reward signal, which can be derived from various sources such as adversarial games, trajectory matching objectives, or optimal transport criteria.

arxiv-2307-02881.title: Probabilistic and Semantic Descriptions of Image Manifolds and Their Applications
arxiv-2307-02881.creator: Peter Tu 1,∗ , Zhaoyuan Yang 1 , Richard Hartley 2 , Zhiwei Xu 2 , Jing Zhang 2 , Yiwei Fu 1 , Dylan Campbell 2 , Jaskirat Singh 2 , and Tianyu Wang 2
arxiv-2307-02881.description: Abstract This paper begins with a description of methods for estimating probability density functions for images that reflects the observation that such data is usually constrained to lie in restricted regions of the high-dimensional image space — not every pattern of pixels is an image.

arxiv-2308-05689.title: Necessary and sufficient conditions for strong stability of explicit Runge–Kutta methods
arxiv-2308-05689.creator: Franz Achleitner, Anton Arnold, Ansgar Jüngel
arxiv-2308-05689.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Franz Achleitner, Anton Arnold, Ansgar Jüngel. Strong stability is a property of time integration schemes for ODEs that preserve temporal monotonicity of solutions in arbitrary (inner product) norms. It is proved that explicit Runge–Kutta schemes of order p ∈ 4 ​ ℕ p\in 4{\mathbb{N}} with s = p s=p stages for linear autonomous ODE systems are not strongly stable, closing an open stability question from [Z. 57 (2019), 1158–1182].

arxiv-2401-10843.title: Training a General Spiking Neural Network with Improved Efficiency and Minimum Latency
arxiv-2401-10843.creator: Yunpeng Yao, Man Wu ∗ \ast, Zheng Chen, Renyuan Zhang
arxiv-2401-10843.description: Abstract Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) that operate in an event-driven manner and employ binary spike representation have recently emerged as promising candidates for energy-efficient computing. However, a cost bottleneck arises in obtaining high-performance SNNs: training a SNN model requires a large number of time steps in addition to the usual learning iterations, hence this limits their energy efficiency.

arxiv-2405-20615.title: The Tolman VII Space-time in the Presence of Charge and a Cosmological Constant
arxiv-2405-20615.creator: James Ripple, Anish Agashe
arxiv-2405-20615.description: Abstract The Tolman VII space-time is one of the few physically acceptable exact solutions in general relativity. In this paper, we derive a generalised Tolman VII solution which includes a charge and a cosmological constant. We analyse the spatial geometry of the solution and present conditions for zero and non-zero spatial curvature.

arxiv-2502-11150.title: Eye Tracking Based Cognitive Evaluation of Automatic Readability Assessment Methods
arxiv-2502-11150.creator: Keren Gruteke Klein, Shachar Frenkel, Omer Shubi, Yevgeni Berzak
arxiv-2502-11150.description: Abstract Automatic methods for scoring text readability have been studied for over a century, and are widely used in research and in user-facing applications in many domains. Thus far, the development and evaluation of such methods have primarily relied on two types of offline human behavioral data, performance on reading comprehension tests and ratings of text readability levels.

arxiv-2506-14416.title: Thermodynamic control of non-equilibrium systems Preprint: Preprint ID
arxiv-2506-14416.creator: Dana Kamp, Karel Proesmans
arxiv-2506-14416.description: Abstract We study the thermodynamic cost associated with driving systems between different non-equilibrium steady states. In particular, we combine a linear-response framework for non-equilibrium Markov systems with Lagrangian techniques to minimize the dissipation associated with driving processes. We then apply our framework to a simple toy model.

arxiv-2602-05772.title: Vortex formation in the Vicsek model with internal chirality of self-propelling objects.
arxiv-2602-05772.creator: Vortex formation in the Vicsek model with internal chirality of self-propelling objects W. T. Gozdz ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, A. Ciach ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}
arxiv-2602-05772.description: Abstract Effect of internal chirality on collective motion of large number of active objects is studied by simulations of appropriately modified Vicsek model. We add a fixed angle to the noise and consider small ratios, p, between this angle and the maximal deviation from the average local direction of motion.

pmc-11525602.creator: Lia C. M. J. Goltstein, Maxim J. P. Rooijakkers, Naomi D. E. Thierens, Selene C. M. Schoormans, Antonius E. van Herwaarden, Hanneke Beaumont, Charles Houdeville, Marlijn P. A. Hoeks, Erwin-Jan M. van Geenen, Sanna R. Rijpma, Xavier Dray, Niels van Royen, Joost P. H. Drenth
pmc-11525602.description: Key PointsQuestionWhat are the associations of transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) with gastrointestinal vascular lesions, including angiodysplasias, in patients with Heyde syndrome?FindingsIn this prospective cohort study including 24 patients with severe aortic stenosis and iron-deficiency anemia, 18 patients (75.0%) were diagnosed with gastrointestinal vascular lesions, known as Heyde syndrome. The mean number of vascular lesions significantly decreased from 6.

pmc-11547659.title: Design of Shape Forming Elements for Architected Composites via Bayesian Optimization and Genetic Algorithms: A Concept Evaluation
pmc-11547659.creator: David O. Kazmer, Rebecca H. Olanrewaju, David C. Elbert, Thao D. Nguyen
pmc-11547659.description: This article presents the first use of shape forming elements (SFEs) to produce architected composites from multiple materials in an extrusion process. Each SFE contains a matrix of flow channels connecting input and output ports, where materials are routed between corresponding ports.

pmc-11627502.title: Epigenetics-targeted drugs: current paradigms and future challenges
pmc-11627502.creator: Wanlin Dai, Xinbo Qiao, Yuanyuan Fang, Renhao Guo, Peng Bai, Shuang Liu, Tingting Li, Yutao Jiang, Shuang Wei, Zhijing Na, Xue Xiao, Da Li
pmc-11627502.description: Epigenetics governs a chromatin state regulatory system through five key mechanisms: DNA modification, histone modification, RNA modification, chromatin remodeling, and non-coding RNA regulation. These mechanisms and their associated enzymes convey genetic information independently of DNA base sequences, playing essential roles in organismal development and homeostasis. Conversely, disruptions in epigenetic landscapes critically influence the pathogenesis of various human diseases.

pmc-12713105.title: Excessive DNA Double‐Strand Breaks–Associated 3D Genome Reorganization Contributes to Neural Tube Defects with Folate Deficiency
pmc-12713105.creator: Ting Zhang, Lin Lin, Jianting Li, Caihua Li, Shengjun Liang, Xuemei Bai, Fang Wang, Yihua Bao, Dan Guo, Xiaochen Bo, Hao Li, Hebing Chen, Qiu Xie
pmc-12713105.description: Neural tube defects (NTDs) are one of the most common congenital malformations. Folic acid deficiency in pregnant women increases the risk of developing NTDs; however, the underlying etiology and mechanisms remain elusive. In this study, the role of DNA double‐strand breaks (DSBs) in 3D genome organization in NTDs with folate deficiency is reported.

pmc-13349868.title: Exacerbated oral pyogenic granuloma in type 2 diabetes mellitus and advanced periodontitis: clinical management and pathophysiological insights: a case report
pmc-13349868.creator: Francisco Javier Alcaraz-Baturoni, Jessica Paola Ibarra-González, Luis Fernando López-Hernández, Mario Alberto Alarcón-Sánchez, Daniel Ortuño-Sahagún, Artak Heboyan, Juan Pablo González-Cárdenas, Sarah Monserrat Lomelí-Martínez
pmc-13349868.description: Oral pyogenic granuloma (OPG) is a benign vascular proliferation that presents as a solitary, pedunculated, or sessile lesion, associated with irritative factors. Various systemic disorders, particularly type 2 diabetes mellitus (DM2), may contribute to its onset and progression through inflammatory and endothelial mechanisms.

pmc-13352789.title: A conserved Sas10/C1D domain protein, CaLrp1, is a critical regulator of hyphal development and pathogenicity in Candida albicans
pmc-13352789.creator: Yang Yang, Dongxu Song, Mingjiao Huang, Chaoqin Sun, Juan He, Ruxia Cai, Weiwei Jin, Na Zhao, Guo Guo
pmc-13352789.description: BackgroundCandida albicans represents the predominant opportunistic fungal pathogen in clinical contexts, with its virulence contingent upon multilayered regulatory networks. CaLrp1 (orf19.5067) encodes a conserved Sas10/C1D domain-containing protein, though its precise biological role has remained uncharacterized.ResultsCaLrp1 deleted and complemented strains were constructed to systematically investigate its function in C. albicans.

pmc-13635187.title: Motifs of brain cortical folding from birth to adulthood
pmc-13635187.creator: Yourong Guo, Mohamed A. Suliman, Logan Z. J. Williams, Renato Besenczi, Kaili Liang, Simon Dahan, Vanessa Kyriakopoulou, Grainne M. McAlonan, Alexander Hammers, Jonathan O’Muircheartaigh, Emma C. Robinson
pmc-13635187.description: Cortical folding of the brain is widely regarded as an interplay between genetic programming and biomechanical forces, closely linked to cytoarchitectonic regionalisation. Abnormal folding patterns are frequently observed in neurodevelopmental conditions and psychiatric disorders. However, significant inter-individual variability of secondary and tertiary folds obscures the detection of shape biomarkers and confounds the investigation of folding-functional relationships.
